title: 第二十三章 肉搏第二十四章 真是他干的
content_zh:
好在这本就是弱肉强食的流放之地，各类蛮横的事情师春早已习惯，故谈不上什么愤怒，只是没想到连执徐城这讲天条的地方也乱了套。
至于单挑决斗，他是不怕的。
他担心的是这次的决斗规则，十声鼓响，十个数内若决不出胜负，交手双方就要一起被处死，给这么短的时间，这算哪门子的决斗？
问题是他这边处死的不止是他，只许一方活着离开，他若败，吴斤两也要跟着一起丢掉性命。
决斗他不怕，可规则上有个致命漏洞，一旦对方发现不敌采取躲避策略，拖过十个数很容易，可以拖大家一起死。
他一边思虑对策，一边趁着身上禁制解开了，赶紧施法检查了一下自己的身体状态。
还好受刑的时间不长，表面看起来伤的不轻，实则都是一些皮肉伤，未伤到筋骨，对他这种以前经常受伤的人来说，早已习惯了。
真正痛苦的是，受刑的时候，右眼的离奇幻景又发作了一回，又把他熬了个够呛。
事发那晚之后，他一直想试着重启一次右眼的幻象，却始终不得其门而入，不想无意中又开启了一回。
就在他默默调节自己身体状态的时候，那个诬告他们的失主也被带来了，依旧还披着那块脏兮兮不知缝补了多少次的破布，面上神色明显透着不安。
不安自有来源，诬告在先本就心里没底，杜火官又说话不算话，承诺的不兑现，这次就算自己打赢了，这边能兑现吗？会不会再次食言？
由不得他多想什么，直接被推搡到了空地上，推到了师春的对面。
确认了要与自己对决的是那个诬告者，师春某种程度上悬着的心，算是放下了。
他之前最怕的还是申尤昆背后的力量把手伸进了城卫中，真要是由那股力量来操控自己生死的话，那自己这次铁定在劫难逃了。
见到了诬告者与自己拼命，说明之前察觉到的审讯风向变了是对的，暗中那股力量已经失去了对此事的操控。
然而不管判断对与否，都要先过了眼前这一关。
咚！
就在对决双方眼中渐出现敌意打量对方时，场边守卫已经操起鼓槌敲响了架子上的鼓。
这一声鼓响，敲的双方忍不住跟着心跳了一下，没想到决斗竟开始的如此草率，连一点准备的机会都不给他们，就这样毫无征兆的开始了。
殊不知看客们可没心思看他们慢慢准备。

两人几乎同时目露凶光，像饿狼一般盯向了对方，只能有一边活着，都没得选择。
两人都没有武器，因为有人说了要看空手肉搏。
咚！
又一声鼓响，十声已去其二。
如此紧迫感，能将人给逼疯，对峙双方无一再敢犹豫，几乎同时唰一声冲向了对方，逃或躲？不可能！
冲击对撞的刹那，诬告者顺势一把扯下了身上的脏兮兮破布甩出，如一道布幕般扑向了撞来的师春，难怪一直披着块破布当衣裳，原来还有这作用。
惯用这手，必有玄虚！
师春瞬间目闪警惕，他是从小一路打杀出来的，经历了太多的凶险，深知对手一旦有抛先手的动作，就要担心是否有后手。
content_en:
Fortunately, this was a place of exile where the weak were the strongest, and Shi Chun had long been accustomed to all kinds of barbaric things, so there was no anger at all, but he didn't expect that even the place where the rule of nature was governed by Xu Cheng would be in chaos.
As for single-on-one duels, he is not afraid.
What he was worried about was the rules of this duel. If there was no winner after ten drums, both parties would be executed together. Given such a short time, what kind of duel was this?
The problem is that he is not the only one who will be executed. Only one party is allowed to leave alive. If he loses, Wu Jinliang will also lose his life.
He is not afraid of duels, but there is a fatal loophole in the rules. Once the opponent discovers that he is losing and adopts an evasive strategy, it is easy to drag him past the tenth number and drag everyone to death.
While he was thinking about countermeasures, he took advantage of the restriction on his body to be released and quickly cast a spell to check his physical condition.
Fortunately, the torture didn't last long. On the surface, the injuries looked serious, but in fact they were just flesh wounds, not muscles or bones. For someone like him, who had been injured frequently in the past, he had long been used to it.
What was really painful was that while he was being tortured, the bizarre scene in his right eye happened again, which made him suffer again.
After the night of the incident, he had been trying to restart the illusion in his right eye, but he was never able to get in, and he accidentally opened it again.
Just as he was silently adjusting his physical condition, the owner who had falsely accused them was also brought in. He was still wearing the dirty rag that had been mended countless times, with an obviously uneasy look on his face.
The uneasiness has its own source. He was already unsure about the false accusation. Du Huoguan kept his word again and failed to fulfill his promise. Even if he wins this time, can he fulfill it here? Will he break his promise again?
He couldn't help but think too much, and was pushed directly to the open space, opposite Shi Chun.
After confirming that the person who was going to confront him was the false accuser, Shi Chun felt relieved to some extent.
What he was most afraid of before was that the power behind Shen Youkun reached into the city guard. If that power really controlled his life and death, then he would definitely be doomed this time.
Seeing the false accuser fighting against him showed that he was right to have noticed that the direction of the interrogation had changed, and that the power in the dark had lost control of the matter.
However, regardless of whether the judgment is correct or not, you must first pass the hurdle in front of you.
Boom!
Just when the two sides were sizing up each other with hostility, the guard on the sidelines had already picked up the drumsticks and beat the drum on the stand.
The sound of the drums sounded, and both parties couldn't help but beat their hearts. They didn't expect that the duel started so hastily, without even giving them a chance to prepare, and it just started without any warning.
Little did they know that the spectators had no intention of watching them prepare slowly.
The two of them had a fierce look in their eyes almost at the same time, staring at each other like hungry wolves. They could only live on one side, and they had no choice.
Neither of them had weapons, because someone said they wanted to watch hand-to-hand combat.
Boom!
There was another drum sound, and two of the ten drums were gone.
Such a sense of urgency can drive people crazy. Neither side of the confrontation dared to hesitate. They rushed towards each other almost at the same time. Escape or hide? impossible!
At the moment of the collision, the false accuser tore off the dirty rags on his body and threw them out, like a curtain, and rushed towards the approaching Shi Chun. No wonder he had been wearing a rag as clothes, it turned out to have this effect.
There must be something mysterious about using this hand!
Shi Chun instantly became alert. He has been fighting since he was a child and has experienced too many dangers. He knows very well that once his opponent makes a move to take the lead, he has to worry about whether he has a back-up move.
